posts.title: Excalidraw Figures in Hugo
posts.description: I love drawing things, especially in Excalidraw! I also need more dark mode support in my life. In this post I’ll go through how I made Excalidraw exports render nicely on my blog in a light or dark mode aware fashion.

posts.title: Introducing snippethost.gitlab.io
posts.description: It is no secret that I’m no big fan of GitHub and it’s dominance in the VCS-ecosystem. So in an effort of leveling the playing field I’m taking it onto myself to build more cool things for and with my VCS of choice, GitLab!
